tagline: Pads, keys, plucks and soundscapes, artist-inspired
description: A two-layer synth for pads, keys, plucks, leads, bells and soundscapes, played from a sunset horizon instead of a wall of knobs: drag the sun for motion and tone, shape the rest with six macros. 70 presets inspired by Tame Impala, Massive Attack, Brent Faiyaz, Mike Dean, Travis Scott, Yeezus and moshc0re, from bare and soft to extreme.
highlights: Eleven sources per layer: Juno-style analog, string machine, formant choir, FM glass, electric piano, pitched air, sine, plucked string, drawbar organ, mallets (marimba, vibes, kalimba, glock, steel) and hard sync
Dirt (8 distortion types), tape wow and saturation, lo-fi, Juno / Solina ensemble, phaser, dub delay, shimmer reverb, tempo pump and gate
Drag the sun to set Motion and Tone; Swell, Tail, Blend, Grit, Echo and Space reshape any preset
POLY switch: play chords with any preset, even the mono leads
70 presets: TAME IMPALA, MASSIVE ATTACK, BRENT FAIYAZ, MIKE DEAN, TRAVIS SCOTT, YEEZUS, MOSHC0RE
installTips: Every macro's centre position is the preset as designed: double-click a knob, or the sun, to go back to it.
Pump, gate, delay and synced LFOs follow FL Studio's tempo.
previewNote: on the same 120 BPM phrase: a held Dm9, an arpeggio over Bb, Fmaj7 stabs, then a legato melody.

items: MOSHC0RE: 10 new presets: a rage supersaw lead, a sample-and-hold techno sequence, a UFO theremin, a vamp cathedral choir, a dub-techno chord, club-light strobes, an 8-bit lead, a pumping machine drone, a soft music box and a hard-techno hoover
